# InvokeAI MCP

> Bridge between AI coding agents and the local InvokeAI creative engine:
> image generation, queue, models, gallery, boards, workflows.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/sandraschi/invokeai-mcp)
- [README](README.md) | [Install](INSTALL.md) | [Onboarding](docs/ONBOARDING.md)
- Full LLM corpus: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Tools

- `invokeai_generate` - txt2img / img2img / inpaint / upscale
- `invokeai_queue` - status, list, result, cancel, clear, resume
- `invokeai_models` - list, install, update, delete, stats
- `invokeai_gallery` - list, search, download, delete, star
- `invokeai_boards` - board CRUD + image assignment
- `invokeai_workflows` - workflow library CRUD
- `invokeai_system` - health, version, config, stats
- Prefab cards: dashboard, queue, models, gallery

## Architecture

- FastMCP 3.4.4+ (stdio + HTTP `/mcp`), Starlette REST `/api/*`
- Graph builders per model family: sd-1, sdxl, flux (verified vs InvokeAI main)
- Webapp: React + Vite + Tailwind dark (ports 11154/11155)
- InvokeAI runs separately on port 9090 (launcher install, never bundled)

## Docs

- `docs/TOOLS.md` - full tool reference
- `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` - env vars (INVOKEAI_URL, ports)
- `docs/ONBOARDING.md` - first-timer setup (InvokeAI install + models)
- `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md` - common issues
